text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — spike in 429s for HelioHealth (tenant=helio-prod) on dedicated pool pv-helio-prod. Auto-detection: 4.2k 429s in last 5m, latency ok. Paging SRE rota. Details: https://console.redwood/ incidents/1749004321 :rotating_light:

sre-ian: acknowledged, joining. Which routes and are we seeing client retries?

oncall-bot: top routes by 429: /v1/generate (72%), /v1/chat (18%). Top callers: helio-api-03 (burst workers), helio-batch-01. Token-bucket drained, pool qps reached configured cap 1200 qps.

dana: I can see the burst at 23:04 UTC from helio-api-03 — steady token consumption pattern, many short-lived connections. Past 10m token fill rate dropped due to global autoscale boundary on the dedicated pool. Posting quick query output:

```
rctl metrics query --pool pv-helio-prod --metric rate_limit_429 --since 10m --agg=1m
23:00  12
23:01  18
23:02  46
23:03  130
23:04  320
23:05  900
23:06  1400
```

maya: probable cause: tenant token-bucket configured in pool-level reservations; we hit the reserved capacity. Two options now: 1) temporary emergency lift / contract override to increase QPS for helio-prod, or 2) apply short-term client-side throttling at edge (WAF) to smooth bursts.

sre-ian: agree. Quick mitigation plan: apply emergency override to pool for helio-prod for 30m to buy breathing room, then instruct Helio to roll out client throttling and backpressure. Julia — can we get acct approval for override? This is billable but urgent.

julia-acct: On it. I pinged the AM and finance lead. I can approve a time-boxed limit increase up to +2x for up to 1 hour. I'll post the signed confirmation here in 2 min.

luca-cs: I'll open a comms channel to Helio and ask them to hold non-critical batch jobs. Tagging them: @helio-prod-oncall (external). ETA to customer notice: 3m.

ops-bot: runbook step: emergency_quota_override recommended. Command: `adminctl pool override --pool pv-helio-prod --tenant helio-prod --qps 2400 --expires-in 3600 --reason "emergency lift for burst"`

sre-ian: running the override now (sudo). Posting command output:

```
$ adminctl pool override --pool pv-helio-prod --tenant helio-prod --qps 2400 --expires-in 3600 --reason "emergency lift for burst"
Applying override... OK
Override id: ov-8732a
New effective tenant qps: 2400 (was 1200)
Expires at: 2025-04-12T00:15:21Z
```

ops-bot: override applied by sre-ian. Notifying autoscaler to accept updated reservation.

dana: metrics now showing 429s dropping — within 90s of override we see backpressure relief: posting new series:

```
23:07  1200
23:08  540
23:09  180
23:10  30
```

helio-cust (via luca-cs): thanks, we see successful requests recovering. We'll pause non-critical batch runs for 30m and roll a client-side retry/backoff toggle.

maya: quick follow-ups: 1) create temporary alert suppression for this tenant so noisy alerts don't page again while we stabilize; 2) schedule a post-incident meeting with Helio for root cause and quota planning; 3) add a canary in pool scaling path to avoid autoscaler boundary next time.

sre-ian: doing alert suppression now: `incctl suppress create --scope tenant:helio-prod --duration 45m --reason "operational mitigation"` — done.

julia-acct: FYI finance approved charge for emergency lift up to 1 hour. I'll send the agreement doc to Helio and record billing override in the CRM.

luca-cs: Customer-facing note sent: "We applied a time-limited increase to your pool quota and recommend throttling batch clients. We'll follow up with details and billing notice."

ops-bot: Reminder: override ov-8732a will expire at 2025-04-12T00:15:21Z unless extended.

dana: marking incident as mitigated in the tracker. No 5xx or degraded latency observed.

sre-ian: handing off to next on-call for follow-up and RCA. @maya please take lead on the postmortem, @julia-acct handle billing comms, @luca-cs keep the customer looped.

maya: will run root cause triage tomorrow — initial hypothesis: token-bucket config mismatch + aggressive client retries. Next steps: collect full traces, check autoscaler logs for scale-out refusal due to capacity limit, and recommend a per-tenant dynamic cap.

sre-ian: thanks team. Closing urgent paging. If 429s reappear reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
